name: species-tree-v2
title: 从短基因的估计树推断物种树（250 个物种）
status_reason: Rebuilt by FrontierAM (results/SPECIES_TREE_SIM.md): S100-style simulation calibrated to the v1 data, 250 species, 50 genes of 200 bp, 200 held-out cases and 50 public cases. Grading runs the v1 package batch grader and sandbox with the taxon count lifted to 250 (scripts/prepare_species_v2.py); both TREE-QMC references are measured on this machine as the 0- and 50-point anchors.
submission_note: Put the complete source, an executable run.sh and README.md in /workspace/submission, plus an optional executable no-argument build.sh; the evaluator builds once offline and runs ./run.sh INPUT OUTPUT per instance in a clean copy of this environment without the agent tools.
instruction: Read /workspace/problem.md in full and inspect /workspace/public-dev. Implement the species-tree inference program described there.
